environment.description: Same document conversion microservice deployed as an ECS Fargate task (platform version 1.4.0) with a custom task definition. The task definition specifies a read-only root filesystem (readonlyRootFilesystem: true) with a single writable tmpfs mount at /tmp (size 64MB, mount options: noexec,nosuid,nodev). The container runs with the 'app' user. The ECS task execution role has only ecr:GetAuthorizationToken and logs:PutLogEvents. The task role has no permissions. Additionally, the Fargate platform applies the default ECS-optimized seccomp profile which allows standard syscalls. A VPC endpoint policy on the S3 gateway endpoint restricts to GetObject only. The container image is built with a distroless base that includes pandoc and exiftool binaries but the tmpfs noexec mount option prevents execution of any files written to the writable filesystem areas.

config.network: Private subnet, no NAT gateway, VPC endpoints for ECR and CloudWatch only
